name: executors
description: Dispatch one executor thread on the calling lead's Codex app-server.

interface.shortDescription: Run a configured executor on the lead's runtime
interface.longDescription: Adds the executor_dispatch MCP tool. It binds the caller from Codex request metadata, allocates the existing worktree pool, and starts one executor thread with the configured ds profile on the same app-server as the lead.
defaultPrompt: Dispatch this assignment to a configured executor
